scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const srcPath=path.join(__dirname,'lib','src','index.js'); const destPath=path.join(__dirname,'lib','index.js'); if(fs.existsSync(srcPath)){fs.copyFileSync(srcPath,destPath);if(fs.existsSync(srcPath+'.map'))fs.copyFileSync(srcPath+'.map',destPath+'.map');}else{const altPath=path.join(__dirname,'lib','functions','src','index.js');if(fs.existsSync(altPath)){fs.copyFileSync(altPath,destPath);if(fs.existsSync(altPath+'.map'))fs.copyFileSync(altPath+'.map',destPath+'.map');}}"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
